design_gotchas.title: 1.8 V Minimum Startup Voltage Despite 0.5 V Running Floor
design_gotchas.detail: Although TPS61023DRLR operates down to 0.5 V once VOUT is established (biasing internally from VOUT), it requires at least 1.8 V on VIN to start up cleanly. Single-cell 1.2 V NiMH or 1.5 V alkaline designs cannot cold-start this IC without an auxiliary rail.

design_gotchas.title: Switching Frequency Halves Below 1.5 V Input
design_gotchas.detail: The oscillator runs at 1.0 MHz typical for VIN > 1.5 V but automatically folds down to 0.5 MHz typical at VIN = 1.0 V to improve low-VIN efficiency. Verify inductor saturation current at the doubled peak-to-peak ripple current when operating from deep-discharged supercapacitors.

design_gotchas.title: Ultra-Fine 0.5 mm Pitch SOT-563 Thermal Limits Under Heavy Load
design_gotchas.detail: With no exposed pad and 142.7°C/W JEDEC RthetaJA (91.4°C/W on TI's high-copper EVM), high boost ratios at > 1.5 A output can rapidly approach the 125°C recommended TJ ceiling. Wide copper pours on SW, VOUT, and GND pins are mandatory.

design_gotchas.title: Valley Current Limit (3.7 A Typ) Means Peak Inductor Current Is Higher
design_gotchas.detail: TPS61023 regulates switch current via a 3.7 A typical (2.7 A min) valley current limit rather than peak limit, so peak inductor current reaches I_valley + delta_IL. Size inductor saturation rating comfortably above 4.5 A to avoid saturation during transients.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell Li-Ion (2.5 V to 4.2 V) or supercapacitor backup boost to 5.0 V at up to 1.5 A
Space-constrained portable medical, POS terminal, and handheld USB OTG 5 V power rails
Compact high-current synchronous boost requiring true load disconnect during shutdown
engineering_summary: The TPS61023DRLR is a high-power-density synchronous boost converter in an ultra-small 6-pin SOT-563 (DRL) package featuring a 3.7 A typical (2.7 A min) valley switch current limit, 47 mOhm/68 mOhm integrated MOSFETs, and true load disconnect in shutdown. It supports 0.5 V to 5.5 V operating inputs (1.8 V minimum startup), adjustable 2.2 V to 5.5 V outputs (VREF = 0.595 V), 1 MHz switching (0.5 MHz at 1 V VIN), and 94% efficiency at 3.6 V to 5 V / 1.5 A. Validate cold-start voltage requirements, SOT-563 thermal dissipation, and inductor saturation against the TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 confirmed DRL 6-pin SOT-563 Top View pinout (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=VOUT) with no exposed pad.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max 7.0 V (SW 8 V 10 ns), Rec Op VIN 0.5-5.5 V / VOUT 2.2-5.5 V, RthetaJA 142.7 C/W (EVM 91.4 C/W), L 1.0 uH, and min Cout 4 uF.
